title: Ability (abilities/*.json, format v1 or v2)
description: One usable ability, in EITHER of two shapes selected by "oneOf" below (versioning note, sub-project 5c: kept as one file with a oneOf split rather than a second ability-v2.schema.json file, so id/name/usage stay documented in exactly one place instead of two documents drifting independently): format v1's direct targeting/attack/hit/miss/effect shape (internal/rules/load.go's loadAbilities), or format v2's composition shape — atom refs + param bindings, flattened into a CompiledPower at load (internal/rules/load.go's loadCompositions + internal/rules/compile.go). id/name/usage are identical, plain fields in both (spec 2026-07-25-format-v2-composition-design.md §3: "usage stays a plain ability field"). This document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

usage.description: Either the bare string "at_will", or an object spending a declared resource.

targeting.description: Format v1 only — format v2's targeting comes from a composed atom's targeting contribution (atom.schema.json) instead.

attack.description: Format v1 only. Omitted entirely on non-attack abilities. When omitted, hit and miss must both be empty or absent.

vs.description: A defense name declared in ruleset.json's defenses list.

compose.description: Format v2 only: the ordered list of atom refs + param bindings this ability composes (spec §4). Execution order is derived from the atoms' declared provides/consumes graph, NOT this list's order (spec §4 guarantee 4: a hand-ordered list is never load-bearing for correctness) — list order is used only to break ties deterministically.

atom.description: An atom id declared under atoms/.

bind.description: param name -> bound value: an integer for an int-kind param, a string (an expression) for an expr-kind param, or a string (a declared name) for an attribute/resource/defense/condition-kind param. Must bind every param the referenced atom declares, and no others (atom.schema.json's params list).

outcome.description: Exactly one of the three keys below.

resource.description: A resource name declared in ruleset.json.

id.description: A condition id declared under conditions/.
